name: Max 10 K Hex Binary Text
definition: Specifies a character string with a maximum length of 10000 binary bytes (20000 hexadecimal text characters).||Used only for hex binary data only, supports only characters A-F and 0-9.
format: Required format is 1 to 10000 bytes, each written as 2 uppercase hexadecimal digits (0-9, A-F)
